arguments.sql:
WITH ranked_tests AS (
    SELECT ID, Date, RNP,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(RNP AS REAL) DESC) AS reading_rank
    FROM main.Laboratory
    WHERE GOT >= 60 AND RNP GLOB '[0-9]*'
)
SELECT ID, Date, RNP
FROM ranked_tests
WHERE reading_rank = 1
ORDER BY ID, Date
LIMIT -1
